name: Breaker
tagline: A stability round for Breaker: a crash fix, GPU smoothness on integrated graphics, and app zoom.

highlights.title: Fixed a crash opening artist pages
highlights.body: An internal index could overflow while an artist page was still loading its real data, crashing the app. Fixed.

highlights.title: Smoother on integrated GPUs
highlights.body: On some hybrid-GPU machines the app could freeze (audio still playing) during heavy navigation or long sessions. Frame pacing, texture uploads, and GPU memory handling are hardened so a hiccup now recovers in under a second instead of freezing, and the correct (usually faster) GPU is now reliably selected on multi-GPU machines.

highlights.title: App zoom
highlights.body: Scale the whole app UI with Ctrl+Plus/Minus/0, Ctrl+mouse-wheel, or the command palette.
